scoring_batch: All unique candidate token sequences for each question, scored as one right-padded batch.
generation: Unconstrained full-vocabulary exact greedy selection. Synchronized wall-clock times for prefill and per generated step at batch size 1. One fresh cache per prompt/method.
exact: Unique canonical full first response line or entire displayed letter, with optional punctuation. Full-answer outputs that only emit a bare letter do not match content. No semantic grading.
